title: 1.108.7 (LTS)
excerpt: Tip The lts image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts to stay on the newest LTS patch Verify this release cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.7 Same command for litellm-database , litellm-non_root and the docker.io/litellm/* images What's new in 1.108.7 (LTS) 14 PRs. 3 added, 8 fixed, 1 changed. 1 needs action Action required Responses API: Set drop_params: true or stop sending Responses-only fields such as max_tool_calls to providers bridged through chat completions ( #48655 ) Also in 1.109.0 Changes Azure: Added gpt-image edits on Azure AI Foundry deployments, including deployments under a custom name ( #49650 ) AWS Bedrock: Added image search on Bedrock knowledge bases with query_image , including image hits in the results ( #51062 ) Vertex AI and Gemini: Fixed Gemini image calls billing text, thinking and Vertex Priority tokens at the wrong rates ( #51017 ) Vertex AI and Gemini: Fixed /gemini batchGenerateContent batches logging $0 with model unknown instead of billing the calling key ( #51279 ) Other providers: Fixed reasoning_effort being dropped or rejected for Baseten models ( #40152 ) Also in 1.109.0 Other providers: Fixed baseten/* listing retired deployment IDs instead of the current Baseten Model APIs ( #46945 ) Also in 1.109.0 Responses API: Fixed missing or repeated sequence_number on bridged /v1/respo
